Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a small right hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (dextroposition of the heart) and a curvilinear opacity in the right lower lung zone (indicated by the arrow), which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein characteristic of Scimitar syndrome. The accompanying CT images confirm right lung hypoplasia and the anomalous venous drainage, ruling out simple collapse or effusion.
